html:
Greetings, Agents.

 

This is CM Fragment of MARVEL Future Fight.


In this patch, you'll encounter 
an expert thief and the Fox deity.


New Tier-4 Advancements and Uniforms have been added for Black Cat, 
who has become the Goddess of Magic through the mighty power of the World Tree, 
and White Fox, who carries out her missions using the spiritual abilities of the Gumiho as her weapon.

 

Agents, please download the 6/9 (Tue) patch 
to check out their new skills and enhanced power!

 

■ 6/9 Patch Details

 

Patch Schedule: 6/10 (Wed) 3:00 (UTC+0), 6/9 (Tue) 20:00 (PDT)

 

[6/10 (Wed) 2:36 (UTC+0), 6/9 (Tue) 19:36 (PDT) added]
The patch has been completed as of 6/10 (Wed) 2:34 (UTC+0), 6/9 (Tue) 19:34 (PDT).
Please reconnect to the game and download the patch file.

 

* The patch completion time may be changed depending on the circumstances.
Completion time will be announced once the patch has been completed.
* The patch will be applied in waves, and the application time may vary by Agent.
* The game can still be accessed during the patch.
When the patch is complete, please restart and apply the patch for better service.

 


▣ Two New Uniforms


Two new Uniforms, Black Cat <Queen in Black>, 
and White Fox <Agent F-One> have been added.


* The skill effects of the new Uniforms are based on the maximum skill level stats.
* The two new Uniforms will be on sale for 40% off during the <The Cat and the Fox Update Celebration Event> and can be checked and purchased in the Marvel Universe and Uniform Room after the Event.


* To celebrate the additional update, a 10% Agent Supplies discount coupon will be distributed.
- Coupon Acquisition & Validity Period: 
6/9 (Tue) 15:00 - 6/23 (Tue) 14:59 (UTC+0),
6/9 (Tue) 8:00 - 6/23 (Tue) 7:59 (PDT)

 

 

 

 

▣ Black Cat & White Fox Tier-4

 

Tier-4 Advancements have been added for Black Cat, 
who followed in her admired father's footsteps to live the life of a master thief, 
and White Fox, who protects her nation by inheriting the mystical powers of the Gumiho.
* The Tier-4 Striker Skill effects are based on Lv.6 stats.

 

 

 

 

▣ New Uniform Collection

 

Check out the new Uniforms inspired by Gods and God Butcher.
Complete the collection by achieving the specified conditions and earn a reward.

 

 


▣ Game Error Fixes


1. The list of Applied Content for X of Swords has been partially updated when viewing other Agents' information.
- Change: Ranked Battle → Team Battle Arena


2. World Boss (Corvus & Proxima): Fixed a translation error regarding the unlock conditions in certain languages.


We look forward to your active participation in the events 
that will be held to support the growth of the updated heroes.


Thank you.
